summary: Sam Altman co-founded Loopt, ran the startup accelerator Y Combinator from 2014 to 2019 and co-founded OpenAI in 2015 with Elon Musk and others, becoming its CEO in 2019. Briefly ousted by OpenAI's board in November 2023 and reinstated days later, he gave $1 million to Trump's 2025 inauguration and launched the $500 billion Stargate AI infrastructure venture with Trump, Larry Ellison and Masayoshi Son. In May 2026 a jury rejected Musk's lawsuit against him and OpenAI.
